description: Additional security-rule findings coverage on small targeted repositories: an empty repository yielding no findings, default permissions on a risky pull_request_target trigger, an injection from untrusted head_ref into a run step, and a self-hosted pull-request job.

files..github/workflows/risky.yml:
on:
  pull_request_target:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo hi

files..github/workflows/inj.yml:
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo ${{ github.head_ref }}

cases.expected_output:
rule=injection level=warning purl=pkg:github/org/owner
  path=.github/workflows/inj.yml line=6 job=build step=0 details=Sources: github.head_ref
